crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because…
Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to…
The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him…
Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite…
Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to…
Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son…
Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His…

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Hagar
people.line: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

translations.web: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
translations.bsb: And Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.
translations.kjv: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
translations.asv: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bare, Ishmael.
